svg.title: One lineage, one snapshot on serverless DataFrame cache
svg.desc: df.cache materializes a session snapshot. DataFrames derived from that variable read it. A new DataFrame with the same plan reads the source tables. The 23 October notes call this Public Preview. The Azure limitations page still says the call raises.

g.text: 23 October notes: Public Preview. Azure limitations still say the call raises.
AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud product notes, and the serverless notes on each cloud.
Feature pages last updated 22 October. AWS and Google Cloud October headers still say 1 October.
On by default. Off for the compliance security profile. An admin can disable it on Previews.
The variable you cached
cache() runs the query before it returns.
The snapshot sits in cloud storage.
persist(storageLevel) ignores the level.
storageLevel reports DISK_ONLY.
filter, select, groupBy, join derived
from this variable read the snapshot.
A second cache() on it does nothing.
Later writes and masks do not reach it.
Session only. At most seven days.
Same plan, new variable
A rebuilt join reads the source tables.
Classic matching used plan shape.
Classic materialization was lazy.
Classic cache was shared on the cluster.
PySpark reference still opens with
MEMORY_AND_DISK_DESER, and the example
still prints InMemoryTableScan.
SQL CACHE TABLE and catalog cache
methods still raise on serverless.
unpersist destroys the lineage. The pages do not share a status.
unpersist ignores blocking, returns immediately, and raises CACHE_DATAFRAME_ACCESS_AFTER_UNCACHE.
A child you cached first keeps its own snapshot. unpersist is not a refresh.
After seven days the lifecycle section says start a new session. CACHE_ENTRY_RESOLUTION_FAILED says call cache() again.
AWS and Google Cloud limitations, 22 October: cache, persist, and unpersist are supported.
Azure limitations, read 23 October: those DataFrame cache APIs are not supported.
AWS migration, 22 October: the calls mostly move unchanged, and the agent still treats them as a hard blocker.
Azure migration, read 23 October: remove the calls. AWS GovCloud, GovCloud DoD, and Azure Government are excluded.
The Google Cloud cache page has no government line. Environment v5. Connect Python 18.1.8. Connect Scala 18.1.5.
Serverless workspace: default storage, and a managed-services customer-managed key when one is set.
Classic workspace: the bucket from workspace creation. Azure names a storage account. No meter on these pages.
Alias sum(amount) before you cache it. The Spark ML 1 GB model cache is a different limit.
